requirement.statement: ExecuteOperationRequest SHALL support an optional closed top-level timeline union for day-granularity as-of, effective-on, and range contexts, while OperationDefinition MAY declare requestable timeline modes and requiredness without changing the five Operation identity dimensions; parser and catalog validation SHALL reject invalid calendar days, non-UTC recorded instants, reversed ranges, unknown fields, missing required context, unsupported modes, or timeline supplied to a non-temporal definition with path-aware issues before runtime allocation.

suite.name: Day timeline request and catalog contract

case.given: as-of, effective-on, and range requests with canonical day values and optional UTC recordedAt
case.when: the public exact parser and JSON roundtrip run
case.then: the timeline discriminant and values SHALL remain exact and legacy requests without timeline SHALL remain valid

case.given: a nonexistent date, non-zero-padded date, timestamp in a day field, reversed range, non-UTC recordedAt, or unknown timeline key
case.then: the request SHALL be rejected at the exact timeline path

case.given: a definition with optional or required day timeline modes and a parsed request
case.then: requiredness, mode, and granularity SHALL match; a definition without timeline SHALL reject a request timeline; no runtime work SHALL run on mismatch
